rationale: Three fixed reconstruction-only diagnostic cases show aligned crop interiors match native inference within 1.2e-7 while 27-40% of full-crop channel samples differ by >1/255. Test reconstruction supervision away from artificial crop boundaries without changing the model or input crop. This is not proof that boundary effects cause all colour/artifact failures.
objective: Mean raw L1 plus 0.2 times (1 minus bounded valid11 SSIM) computed on central128 of unchanged256 input crops; no identity/perceptual/adversarial term.
optimizer_policy: Initialize from the original V2 epoch20 source, not any identity treatment or continued control; fresh AdamW exactly as matched completed control, same seed and augmentation epochs20/21.
compute_budget: One new treatment, two epochs / 714 new optimizer steps. Reuse completed control and diagnostic40; evaluate40 treatment native images. Eight fixed PNG border/interior MSE checks per arm, no extra model forwards. No training at other seeds/margins or automated sweep.
limitations: L1 supervises25% as many output pixels; SSIM uses118x118 instead of246x246 valid window positions, so supervision coverage is a confound.
Does not add global scene context, remove reflection padding for small training inputs, or guarantee colour improvement.
Native image edges may degrade after excluding artificial crop edges; inspect fixed native16-pixel bands and whole-image/corner crops.
Same diagnostic set has been used adaptively; continuation is exploratory, not independent generalization evidence.
continuation_criteria: Both native diagnostic mean PSNR and SSIM must meet or exceed matched control.
Mean per-image16-pixel border PNG MSE over the fixed eight must not increase; supplementary 8-bit metric, not native-float primary PSNR/SSIM.
Inspect fixed eight cases at native edges and interior/contour ROIs: no new major defects; do not accept aggregate means alone.
If any criterion fails, do not promote or automatically sweep margins. Even success requires a separately declared full-baseline protocol and formal selection/artifact gates.
selection_policy: Diagnostic pilot bundles remain forbidden from selection; selection, final test and challenging inputs stay sealed.
